Bundled font notices
====================

The dashboard redistributes the following unmodified font software under the
SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The full license is in OFL-1.1.txt.

Source: https://github.com/rsms/inter

Source: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono
